description_for_human: Send Carrier OTPs, dispatch verified bot notifications, and interact with Autonomous Business AI Concierge via Zenoa by Inolas Nexus.
description_for_model: Plugin and tool suite for Zenoa APIs. Allows AI models to dispatch carrier-verified OTPs (/api/v1/otp/send, /api/v1/otp/verify), send bot notifications (/api/v1/bot/send), and query business AI customer conversations (/api/business/chat). Authenticate with API Key using Bearer token or X-Zenoa-Api-Key.
